resources.string: Android will ask for permission to share your screen. Without it, streaming cannot start. You can stop sharing at any time.
Notifications show stream status and error alerts. Use them to stop streaming or reopen ScreenStream.

Allow ScreenStream to use your local network for streaming to other devices on the same network.\n\nAndroid describes this permission as access to Nearby devices and may mention determining their relative position.
In app settings, open Permissions and allow Nearby devices to stream to devices on the same local network.
Allow microphone access to include sound from your microphone in the stream.\n\nWithout it, microphone audio cannot be streamed.
Android requires microphone permission to stream device audio. This does not turn on your microphone.\n\nOnly audio that Android and the playing app allow to be shared can be streamed.
Allow microphone access to stream microphone and device audio.\n\nDevice audio can be streamed only when Android and the playing app allow sharing it.
Allow microphone access in app settings to stream microphone or device audio.\n\nWithout it, audio cannot be streamed.
